items.evidence: python game.py --headless --seed 1 --ticks 0 --settings s1.json printed {"tick":0,"screen":"title","menu_index":0,"language":"en","volume":5,"texts":["Hold the gate","Start","Settings","Quit"],"score":0,"wave":1,"gate_health":5,"guard_y":6.0,"walkers":[],"bolts":[]} - all brief keys present.
README frame command (--ticks 700 --script '0:enter,1:shoot' --frame out.png) wrote out.png; IHDR reads 800x480; every other frame I made was 800x480 as well.
Title texts [Hold the gate, Start, Settings, Quit]; script 0:down,1:enter -> screen settings; 0:enter -> screen play, wave 1, score 0, gate_health 5.
9 rights from 5 -> volume 10 (it stops at 10); 13 lefts -> volume 0 (it stops at 0); 2 lefts -> 3, 1 right -> 4.

Settings, right on Volume then down+right on Language -> texts [Configuración, Volumen: 6, Idioma: Español, Volver]; the next runs show title [Defiende la puerta, Empezar, Configuración, Salir], play [Puntos: 10, Oleada 1 de 5, Puerta: 5], pause [.., En pausa, Continuar, Título]. No English is left and nothing is missing.
The run that set volume 6 + es wrote l1.json {"volume":6,"language":"es"}; a second run with --settings l1.json started language es volume 6. A fresh path fresh_dir/x.json started en/5.
Holding up 30 ticks: guard_y 6.0 -> 9.0; holding down 30 ticks -> 3.0 (6 u/s). Held up for 200 ticks it stays at 12.0; held down for 300 ticks it stays at 0.0.

Shoot held from tick 1: at tick 25 there is 1 bolt and at tick 26 a second one appears at x 2.2333 (24 ticks apart). Bolt +0.2333/tick = 14 u/s. A bolt in a lane with no walker was at x 19.9667 at tick 97 and was gone at tick 98.
Idle seed 1: walkers spawn at x 20 on ticks 2, 92, 182, 272, 362 (90 ticks = 1.5 s), 5 in total, lanes 6,2,2,2,8, moving x -0.025/tick (1.5 u/s); there is no 6th walker at tick 600.

A single bolt at y 6: at tick 71 the walker's health is 2->1 and the bolt is gone. Two bolts: walker gone and score 10 by tick 100. A bolt at y 6.7 (0.7 off lane) passed the walker, which kept health 2; a bolt at y 6.6 hit.

Idle: walker reaches x 0.0 at tick 802 and at tick 803 it is gone with gate_health 5->4. At tick 1200 screen lost, texts [You lost, Score: 0, Enter: title], gate_health 0; the lost frame shows YOU LOST and SCORE: 0.
Wave 1's last walker was gone at tick 1163; wave 2's first walker spawned at tick 1343 (180 ticks = 3 s); 7 walkers at tick 2000; texts 'Wave 2 of 5'.
Input scripts made by my own aim-and-shoot planner, replayed through the CLI: seeds 1 and 7 end screen won, score 450, gate 5 at tick 5300; seed 3 with enter at tick 5420 -> screen title.

Escape at tick 100: the state at tick 300 is identical to the state at tick 100 (walkers, bolts, score). Resume (enter at 300) gives tick 401 = the unpaused state at tick 200. Escape, down, enter -> title.
Seed 5, the same script, 700 ticks run twice: the outputs are byte-identical (cmp). Wave 1 lanes: seed1 [6,2,2,2,8], seed2 [8,2,8,8,10], seed5 [2,2,10,2,10], seed42 [4,4,2,6,10].

In play_en.png (seed 2, tick 400) the guard is at (80,282) for y 5.4, walker (10.05,8) at (402,187), walker (12.3,2) at (492,407), and the bolts are at x 136/360/584 on y 282 - all match px=x*40, py=40+(12-y)*440/12. The gate is drawn as a bar at the left. The HUD shows SCORE: 0, WAVE 1 OF 5, GATE: 5.
title_en/title_es/set_en/set_es PNGs show the menus with '> item <' on the chosen entry (START, EMPEZAR, VOLUME: 5, IDIOMA: ESPAÑOL) in the chosen language, with accents and Ñ drawn.
Strings are in lang/en.json and lang/es.json (same keys) and game.py loads every lang/*.json. README section 'Add a language' says to copy en.json to <code>.json and translate it.
README 'Play' gives the keys and goal; I ran both of its commands (headless with a JSON inputs file, and the frame with an inline script) as written: they print the JSON and write an 800x480 PNG.

defects: The run counts as won when wave 5's last walker reaches the gate rather than being destroyed (gate still standing): a seed 1 run that let that walker through ended won with 440 points and gate 4. The brief says the run is won when that walker is destroyed.
On the won/lost frames the top HUD bar repeats the result texts (e.g. 'YOU LOST / SCORE: 0 / ENTER: TITLE') instead of score/wave/gate.
Spanish 'Enter: título' keeps the English key name 'Enter' on the won/lost screens.
After returning to the title from pause or won/lost, the printed state still carries the old score, wave, walkers and bolts until Start is chosen again.
The tkinter window title 'Hold the gate' is hard-coded in game.py and not taken from the string tables (from reading the code; I did not open the window).

where.how: weighted_by_kind is exact (the run's own token counts times the weights); a step's kind is a reading of its command's text, and answered_tokens / written_tokens are characters / 4
